description: Unsigned transactions for one vault action (supply, borrow, repay or withdraw) and one amount, ready to be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet. Nothing is signed or sent by this server.

amount.description: Amount in token units, digits with an optional decimal point, for example 25.5

vault.description: Token symbol, vault id or vault address

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send
